questions.q: What namespace does a registered model use in Unity Catalog?
options: A flat, single-part model ID with no catalog or schema
The same three-level catalog.schema.model namespace tables use
A separate 'models' namespace unrelated to catalogs and schemas
The Databricks workspace ID followed by a run ID
questions.explain: Registered models use the exact same catalog.schema.model three-level namespace as tables, which is what lets them inherit the same owners, permissions, and audit trail as any other object in that schema.

questions.q: What MLflow call points the client at Unity Catalog as the model registry, instead of the legacy workspace registry?
questions.explain: mlflow.set_registry_uri("databricks-uc") is the real call that directs mlflow.register_model() to register into Unity Catalog rather than the legacy Workspace Model Registry.

questions.q: What do model version aliases (like Champion) replace?
options: The fixed Staging/Production/Archived stages from the legacy registry
questions.explain: Aliases are a mutable, user-defined pointer to a specific version, replacing the old fixed-stage lifecycle concept — promoting a model is just moving the alias to a new version.

questions.q: Which privilege is required to load a registered model and run inference against it?
questions.explain: EXECUTE is the privilege that lets a principal view and load a registered model for inference — registered models are governed as a subtype of the FUNCTION securable object, using EXECUTE the same way a function does.

questions.q: What does logging a training dataset with mlflow.log_input() enable in Unity Catalog?
options: Automatic retraining of the model every night
A lineage link from the model version to the table it was trained on, visible on the model's Lineage tab
Automatic masking of any PII columns in the training table
A share that exposes the training table to external recipients
questions.explain: Logging the input dataset lets Unity Catalog draw a real lineage connection from the model version to its upstream training table, shown on that model version's own Lineage tab in Catalog Explorer.
